# Anadolu Ajansı

> Turkey's leading news agency providing comprehensive coverage of breaking news, international affairs, geopolitics, and regional conflicts across 15+ language editions.

Anadolu Ajansı (AA) is a major Turkish news agency and aggregator delivering real-time coverage of domestic and international events. The platform serves a global audience through multiple language editions including Turkish, English, Arabic, Russian, French, Persian, Kurdish, and others, with specialized sections covering current events, world news, economics, sports, culture, and geopolitical analysis.

## Key Topics

- Anadolu Ajansı
- Turkey/Türkiye
- Middle East politics
- International relations
- Geopolitics
- Iran
- Israel
- NATO
- Breaking news
- Regional conflicts
- World news
- Current events
- Conflict reporting
- International affairs
- Syria

## Core Language Editions

- [Turkish Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr): Turkish homepage of Anadolu Ajansı news agency with multi-category coverage
- [English Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/en): English language version of Anadolu Ajansı trusted news source
- [Arabic Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/ar): Arabic language news portal by Anadolu Ajansı for Middle East coverage
- [Russian Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/ru): Russian language news portal for Anadolu Ajansı international coverage
- [French Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/fr): French language edition of Anadolu Ajansı news aggregator
- [Persian Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/fa): Persian language news portal covering Iran-Turkey relations

## Regional Language Editions

- [Bosnian Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/ba): Bosnian language edition of Anadolu Ajansı news aggregator
- [Kurdish Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/kk): Kurdish language edition of Anadolu Ajansı news agency
- [Kurmanji Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/ks): Kurmanji Kurdish language news from Anadolu Ajansı
- [Albanian Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/sq): Albanian language edition of Anadolu Ajansı news agency
- [Macedonian Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/mk): Macedonian language edition of Anadolu Ajansı news aggregator
- [Indonesian Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/id): Indonesian language news from Anadolu Ajansı trusted source
- [Spanish Edition](https://www.aa.com.tr/es): Spanish language edition of Anadolu Ajansı news agency

## News Categories

- [Current Events & Breaking News](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/gundem): Turkish current events and breaking news section of Anadolu Ajansı
- [World News](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/dunya): World news and international affairs coverage by Anadolu Ajansı
- [Analysis & Geopolitics](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/analiz): Geopolitical analysis and international relations commentary
- [Economics & Energy](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/ekonomi): Economic news and energy sector coverage by Anadolu Ajansı
- [Sports](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/spor): Sports news covering volleyball, basketball, and Turkish leagues
- [Culture & Heritage](https://www.aa.com.tr/tr/kultur): Turkish culture, heritage, and arts coverage by Anadolu Ajansı
